item.title: Version 0.8.0
item.description:
What's New

  • A redesigned management window: every page shares one layout, with a frosted background and Liquid Glass controls
  • Overview shows your wallpapers on a 3D shelf; drag a card onto a display, or drop Finder files on the shelf to add them
  • Hover a card to play its GIF preview
  • Wallpaper transitions: crossfade, Meteor, Ink Bloom, Light Leak, Aurora Curtain, Light Weave or random (Settings → General)
  • The overlay editor gets Layers and Effect Layer panels, a preview mode and an Add Widget drawer
  • Saved shows Bookmarks and Schemes side by side; Pro can bookmark Workshop items before downloading
  • Daily Schedule gets preset slots and an editable timeline

Improvements

  • Library and Workshop items open in one detail view that shows the preview at its real size
  • Search the library by Workshop ID or type; Settings search jumps to the matching row
  • The status capsule shows memory, battery and what raised the load
  • Audio capture and weather location run only with your consent and only while in use
  • Web wallpapers can no longer ask for camera, microphone or location

Bug Fixes

  • Clicks on empty parts of an interactive widget now reach the desktop
  • Retry reapplies the wallpaper that actually failed
  • Cancelling a download no longer interrupts a wallpaper being applied
  • Pro: Workshop items imported from Steam's folder keep their ID and show as in use

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen.app" once; updates Loomscreen installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
